mapper.insert: insert into student_point_exchange (exchange_id, user_id, stage, item_code, item_name, cost_points, balance_after, create_time) values (#{exchangeId}, #{userId}, #{stage}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{costPoints}, #{balanceAfter}, now())
mapper.select: select count(1) from student_point_exchange e where e.user_id = #{userId} and e.item_code = #{itemCode}
select distinct e.item_code from student_point_exchange e where e.user_id = #{userId}
